replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the equation in standard quadratic form: ax²+bx+c=0. Then, compute the discriminant (b²-4ac) to determine the nature of the roots. To find stationary points, first compute the derivative f '(x) of the function. Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for stationary points.
